Sub.: Intimation under Regulation 30(6) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing 
Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Audio recording of Earnings 
Conference Call with Analysts / Investors on Financial Results for the Quarter and Financial 
Year ended March 31, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with Schedule III, Part A, Para A of the Securities and Exchange 
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to 
inform you that the audio recording of Earnings Conference Call with Analysts / Investors held on 
Wednesday, May 20, 2026 at 05:30 P.M. (IST) to discuss the Audited Financial Results of the 
Company for the Quarter and Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 is available on the website of the 
Company 
and 
the 
same 
can 
be 
accessed 
at 
https://ompowertransmission.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/05/Audio-Recording-of-Earnings-Conference-Call-Q4-FY26.mp3 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For, Om Power Transmission Limited  
(Formerly known as Om Power Transmission Private Limited) 
 
 
Hardik Patel
